name: necturalabs
description: NecturaLabs Agent Skills, plus a pinned entry for every plugin the NecturaLabs setup uses that no official or vendor marketplace carries. Third-party entries install straight from their upstream repositories; this repository redistributes none of their code.

plugins.name: necturalabs
plugins.description: NecturaLabs Agent Skills: five skills for instruction files, orchestration, independent review, testing and project docs, plus fab for the Fab asset marketplace.

plugins.name: security-audit
plugins.description: Cloudflare's security-audit skill, installed from cloudflare/security-audit-skill at c1c8a8c (MIT). Nothing is redistributed here.

plugins.name: superpowers
plugins.description: obra/superpowers 6.4.1, installed from upstream at 5bf4e78 (MIT) and run as written, SessionStart hook included.

plugins.name: web-design-guidelines
plugins.description: Vercel's web-design-guidelines skill (the Web Interface Guidelines as a UI audit), installed from vercel-labs/agent-skills at 063bee9. Upstream declares no license for it; nothing is redistributed here.

plugins.name: remotion
plugins.description: Remotion's Agent Skills, installed from remotion-dev/skills at 4.0.527 (9682e99). Upstream declares no license; Remotion itself is under the Remotion License. Nothing is redistributed here.

plugins.name: vercel-composition-patterns
plugins.description: Optional: React composition patterns that scale. Installed from vercel-labs/agent-skills at 063bee9 (skills/composition-patterns, MIT).

plugins.name: vercel-react-view-transitions
plugins.description: Optional: React View Transition API animations. Installed from vercel-labs/agent-skills at 063bee9 (skills/react-view-transitions, MIT).

plugins.name: vercel-react-native-skills
plugins.description: Optional: React Native and Expo best practices. Installed from vercel-labs/agent-skills at 063bee9 (skills/react-native-skills, MIT).

plugins.name: blender-lab-mcp
plugins.description: Connects the official Blender Lab MCP server (projects.blender.org/lab/blender_mcp ff54e4d8, GPL-3.0, installed from upstream) to the harness.

plugins.name: godot-mcp-toolkit
plugins.description: Connects NPGameDev's Godot MCP Toolkit bridge 1.0.2 (MIT, installed from upstream) to the harness.

plugins.name: typescript-native-lsp
plugins.description: TypeScript 7 native language server (tsc --lsp --stdio). Claude Code only.
